title: 3I/ATLAS anomalous composition

tellings.quote:
nickel go together. So now you
have something that is nickel and not iron.

plain: A physicist who studies UFO reports, Kevin Knuth, talks about 3I/ATLAS, an object from outside our solar system that passed through it in 2025. He says its makeup is odd: it shows nickel without the iron that normally goes with it, a point he links to the Harvard astronomer Avi Loeb. If so, it would hint that the object is not a normal natural rock.
